title: Alcohol-Free Savings vs Goal
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:alcohol
| search saved_amount=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(saved_amount) as saved_amount avg(goal_pct) as avg_goal_pct by _time goal_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks alcohol-free savings over time and breaks it out by goal.
value: Savings versus goal gives the cutback effort a reinforcing financial story, not just deprivation.
implementation: Send alcohol-free savings events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of alcohol-free savings by goal.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates how alcohol-free savings changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
